groups.title: Background Job Concepts
groups.question: Signing up takes seconds because the welcome email is sent during the request, and sometimes the email service fails. Explain how you would move this to the background.

followUps.Active Job abstraction and adapter patte: What does Active Job give you?
followUps.Job retries, error handling, and dead qu: How should a job handle failures?
followUps.Action Mailer email composition and deli: How do mailers and deliver_later work together?

evidence.text: Active Job is one interface for writing background jobs.
The backend, such as Sidekiq, is chosen with an adapter.
Changing the backend does not require rewriting the jobs.
retry_on retries a job on given errors with increasing waits.
discard_on drops jobs that fail in ways retrying cannot fix.
Jobs that keep failing end up in a dead queue for inspection.
Mailer classes build emails from templates.
deliver_later queues the email as a background job.
The request returns immediately while the email is sent separately.

groups.title: Email Templates and Testing
groups.question: Your emails look broken in some email clients and you keep sending yourself test emails to check templates. Explain how you would build and preview emails.

followUps.Email templates HTML and text multipart: Why send both HTML and plain-text versions?
followUps.Mailer previews for development email te: How do mailer previews speed up email work?

evidence.text: Rails renders both an HTML and a plain-text template.
Some email clients or users only show plain text.
Multipart emails are more compatible and less likely to look like spam.
Previews render emails in the browser.
Nothing is actually sent.
You can change templates and refresh to see the result.

groups.title: Sidekiq and Redis Setup
groups.question: You chose Sidekiq for background jobs and need to see queue backlogs and failed jobs. Explain how Sidekiq works and how you monitor it.

followUps.Sidekiq Web UI for job monitoring: What does the Sidekiq web UI show and how do you protect it?

evidence.text: Sidekiq stores queued jobs in Redis.
Each worker process runs many jobs at once using threads.
This handles high job volumes with fewer processes.
It shows queue sizes, processed jobs, failures and retries.
It is mounted as a route in the app.
It must be behind authentication, since it can retry or delete jobs.

notEnough: Only saying it is a dashboard.

groups.title: Job Scheduling and Reliability
groups.question: You need a daily digest email and production emails must be delivered reliably. Explain how you would schedule jobs and configure delivery.

followUps.Scheduling recurring jobs with sidekiq-c: How would you schedule a job to run every day?
followUps.Email delivery with SendGrid and Postmar: How do you send production email through a provider like Postmark?

evidence.text: sidekiq-cron adds cron-style schedules to Sidekiq.
Schedules are defined in a configuration file.
Scheduled jobs appear in the Sidekiq web UI.
Action Mailer is configured with the provider's SMTP or API settings.
Credentials come from environment variables or encrypted credentials.
Providers improve delivery and give bounce and open tracking.
